name: Claude Code
cross_check: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog — confirm the npm dist-tag has a matching changelog entry before syncing content
release_notes: Use the official changelog page directly; each entry there is already scoped to what shipped in that release.
gotchas: npm dist-tags.latest can land ahead of the changelog page by a few hours — cross-check before syncing content, not just the version number.

Two independent version numbers are tracked on this placemat: the template version (this page's own structure, bumped only on structural/visual redesigns) and the CC release version (content, updated on every sync). Only the CC release version drives the header's 'As of release' tag and the changelog's Content/Release sections.

The standalone claude-code-placemat repo used class="new" and an <!-- added:vX.Y.Z --> comment to mark recent items directly in index.html. That convention is gone — this template computes 'new' per visitor at runtime from changes.json (house AGENTS.md); never write class="new" into index.html.
JSON settings that only apply in managed/enterprise policy files belong in the 'Managed & Enterprise' group of the Settings (JSON) card, not in the general settings groups.

docs.slash_commands and docs.settings were stale (the vendor renamed /docs/en/slash-commands to /docs/en/commands, and /docs/en/settings is now a precedence overview rather than the exhaustive key reference, which moved to /docs/en/settings-reference) — fixed while building the Task 5 inventory (2026-09-13).

The commands reference table only lists the primary form of a command; several real commands are documented only as an 'Alias:'/'Aliases:' note in another row's cell (e.g. /undo, /checkpoint, /proactive, /settings, /checkup) — the inventory.slash array folds those in too.

/output-style and /commit-push-pr are real (confirmed via the official changelog: /output-style was re-added in v2.1.269 after an earlier deprecation; /commit-push-pr is a bundled skill referenced across several changelog entries) but neither appears in the current commands reference table — included in inventory.slash on release-notes confirmation per the Task 5 brief.

bashEditDiffEnabled and gatewayInternalNetworks are documented only in the changelog (v2.1.269 and v2.1.268) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation.

allowed_domains is a per-command field on Bash/PowerShell/Monitor in sandboxed auto mode (v2.1.271 changelog), not a settings.json key, but it appears as a bare <code> chip in the placemat's Settings card like the other hook/status-line fields below — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation, not yet in settings-reference.md.

inventory.hooks mixes true lifecycle event names with a few other bare <code> chips from the same card (continueOnBlock, terminalSequence — hook I/O fields per hooks.md; alwaysLoad — an MCP server config field per mcp.md, since the placemat's MCP Servers group lives inside card-hooks) — all are documented verbatim in the vendor docs, just not as event names.

inventory.settings likewise carries a few dotted identifiers that are hook input / status line stdin JSON fields rather than settings.json keys, because they appear as bare <code> chips in the placemat's Settings card: autoMode.hard_deny (settings-reference.md), statusLine.refreshInterval, workspace.git_worktree, effort.level and prompt_cache (all statusline.md) — every one is verbatim in the vendor docs, just not in settings-reference.md's own key index.

syncClaudeAiPlugins is documented only in the changelog (v2.1.275, alongside the already-listed syncClaudeAiSkills) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation.

maxProseWidth and allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp are documented only in the changelog (v2.1.282) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation.
availableModelsMatch and deniedModels are documented only in the changelog (v2.1.283) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation.

v2.1.284 changed /effort's ultracode argument: commands.md now documents `/effort [level|auto|status|ultracode [on|off]]`, where `ultracode`/`ultracode on` turns Ultracode on at the current effort level (no longer forcing xhigh) and `ultracode off` turns it off (previously failed with Invalid argument); paired with new effortSlider:decreaseEffort/increaseEffort/toggleUltracode keybinding actions (Tab toggles Ultracode in the interactive slider) confirmed via the v2.1.284 changelog.

v2.1.284's changelog documents `/mcp reconnect all`, but commands.md's own /mcp syntax line (`/mcp [reconnect <server>|enable|disable [<server>|all]]`) still shows only single-server reconnect as of the 2026-09-29 fetch — included on changelog confirmation per the release_notes rule; re-check commands.md on a future sync and drop this gotcha once it lists reconnect all explicitly.
allowedProviders is documented only in the changelog (v2.1.285) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on release-notes confirmation.

allowManagedModsOnly is documented verbatim on the new Mods overview page (docs/en/plugins/mods/overview, v2.1.287) and not yet in settings-reference.md — included in inventory.settings on that page's confirmation.

bareElicitationCapability (MCP server config) is documented only in the changelog (v2.1.287) and not yet in mcp.md — included in inventory.hooks (the MCP Servers group lives inside card-hooks) on release-notes confirmation.

/plugin-authoring is a new skill-backed command confirmed directly in commands.md itself ("Requires Claude Code v2.1.287 or later"), introduced alongside the new Mods feature (docs/en/plugins/mods/overview) — the built-in plugin that provides it is cc-plugin-plugin-authoring.

CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR, and its 100-calls/hour default, are stated verbatim in the v2.1.290 changelog entry ("refill over time (100 calls/hour; CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR sets the rate, 0 turns it off)") but not yet in env-vars.md, which as of the 2026-10-05 fetch still describes CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION as a one-time cap with no refill — included on release-notes confirmation per the release_notes rule; re-check env-vars.md on a future sync.

claude attach <id|name> and claude logs <id|name> (card-cli) are not new commands but were missing from the placemat; added now because the v2.1.290 changelog and cli-reference.md both confirm the new partial-name matching feature for them.

claude plugin install's --marketplace <source> flag is stated verbatim in the v2.1.292 changelog but not yet in plugins/cli-reference.md's install flag table as of the 2026-10-06 fetch — included on release-notes confirmation per the release_notes rule; re-check plugins/cli-reference.md on a future sync. The same sync added a claude plugin install <plugin> row to card-skills's Plugin CLI Commands group, which had none before, sourced from plugins/cli-reference.md's own install section for the rest of the row.

CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS is stated verbatim in the v2.1.292 changelog but not yet in env-vars.md as of the 2026-10-06 fetch — included on release-notes confirmation per the release_notes rule; re-check env-vars.md on a future sync.

v2.1.292 changed MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy's scope: local (stdio) MCP server connections now negotiate protocol 2026-07-28 by default on every install (not only Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled ones, as before) — recorded as a note on the existing row per the house rule against extending summaries.

agentType (a subagentStatusLine task field) is confirmed directly in statusline.md's own Task fields table, introduced in v2.1.293 ('Requires Claude Code v2.1.293 or later') — added to inventory.settings and given its own row in the Key JSON Settings group, alongside the other status line stdin field chips (workspace.git_worktree, effort.level, prompt_cache).
